items.stem: Gemini returns a confident summary stating last quarter grew 12%. What should you do before sharing it?

options.text: Verify the 12% against the source rows yourself
options.rationale: Correct: AI output must be checked against the data; confident wording is not evidence.

options.text: Share it immediately because the tone is confident
options.rationale: Confidence is not correctness; unverified figures can be wrong.

options.text: Delete the source data to keep the sheet tidy
options.rationale: Removing source data makes verification impossible.

options.text: Ask Gemini if it is sure
options.rationale: Re-asking the model does not independently confirm the number.

items.explanation: Correct: AI output must be checked against the data; confident wording is not evidence.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which is the safest practice when a dataset contains regulated personal data?

options.text: Confirm data-handling policy and admin controls before using the assistant
options.rationale: Correct: data boundaries and governance must be confirmed first.

options.text: Paste everything so the model has full context
options.rationale: Sending regulated data without checking policy risks a breach.

options.text: Rename the sheet to hide the content
options.rationale: Renaming does not change what data is processed.

options.text: Assume the assistant never stores anything
options.rationale: Assumptions about retention are not a substitute for confirming policy.

items.explanation: Correct: data boundaries and governance must be confirmed before sending regulated data.

items.stem: Which TWO steps help verify an AI-generated summary of a table? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Trace each cited figure back to specific source cells
options.rationale: Correct: tracing to source confirms the figure exists in the data.

options.text: Recompute a key total manually and compare
options.rationale: Correct: an independent manual total catches generation errors.

options.text: Increase the font size of the summary
options.rationale: Formatting has no bearing on correctness.

options.text: Accept it if it reads fluently
options.rationale: Fluency is unrelated to numerical accuracy.

items.explanation: Correct: tracing to source cells and recomputing a total independently both verify generated figures.
